summary: Stone County steel lookout at Rushing, 100 ft with an observation cabin, described in a 1954 federal survey; no construction, staffing or current-status source found.

facts.design: steel four-legged tower supporting an observation cabin

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station description records the 100-foot steel tower with an observation cabin at Rushing.

notes_for_editor: No source read gives a construction date, staffing, fire record, fate or current status. The survey text is read through the central lookouts page; the NGS datasheet (PID FG1672) was not fetched directly. Brief height 30.5 m matches the 100 ft in cite 1; brief agency matches cite 1. Searches for a Rushing-specific tower history found only the town entry (cite 3) and general state material.
